retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait featuring a subject in a complex rhinestone mesh veil against a vibrant, glowing circular halo with vertical side-aligned typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast portrait of a person wearing an intricate, draped rhinestone headpiece that veils the face. The subject is framed by a large, glowing yellow-to-pink gradient orb, set against a textured, smoky blue-grey background. Text is oriented vertically along the left edge.
coreVisualRelationships: The circular halo acts as a frame for the head and shoulders.
The rhinestone mesh creates a complex texture that contrasts with the smooth skin.
Vertical typography balances the central circular composition.
Warm internal lighting on the face contrasts with the cool atmospheric background.
coreInvariants: Intricate rhinestone or crystal mesh draping over the face
Vertical text alignment along the left vertical axis

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium close-up portrait from chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes visible through the rhinestone mesh.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the glowing halo to the face, then down the draped jewels to the vertical text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Textured atmospheric space in the corners outside the central orb.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm yellow and pink gradient within the central orb.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool muted blue and grey in the background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: High-key white specular highlights on the rhinestones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the center fading to desaturated textures at the edges.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between display title and metadata text
Elongated proportions for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Custom stylized glyphs for the main title with sharp, angular terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly stylized, angular display face paired with a clean, minimal geometric sans-serif for secondary info.
graphicDevices: Small metadata text in the top left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, futuristic aesthetic of the main title.
Appropriate for the clean, geometric secondary metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a person with iridescent skin wearing a complex rhinestone mesh veil. Place a large glowing yellow and pink circular orb behind the head. The background should be a smoky, textured blue-grey.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical text along the left margin, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise. Use a stylized angular font for the main title and a small geometric sans-serif for the name at the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Is the text oriented vertically on the left?
Is the rhinestone mesh detailed and reflective?
Is the circular halo a smooth yellow-to-pink gradient?
Is the background textured and cool-toned?

adjustableVariables: Font weight of the vertical text
mustRedesign: Unique jewelry patterns that are trademarked

mustAchieve: Realistic light refraction in the crystals
Smooth color transitions in the halo
Clear legibility of the vertical text
avoid: Cluttered backgrounds that obscure the silhouette

postGenerationChecks: Check that the rhinestone veil follows the contours of the face.
Ensure the vertical text does not overlap the central subject.
Verify the glow from the orb interacts with the subject's shoulders.
Confirm the background texture is visible but not distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Jeweled Mesh + Gradient Orb Backdrop + Vertical Left-Aligned Typography
